question: What is the bottom-line institutional verdict on SK hynix (NASDAQ: SKHY) for both new capital and our 17.764 held Schwab shares?

epigraph.quote: Separate the brilliance of the factory from the price and trend of the stock; both must align before capital earns its keep.
epigraph.author: Dual-Verdict Underwriting Standard

web_blocks.html: SK hynix (NASDAQ: SKHY / KRX: 000660) has engineered a historic fundamental ascent, capturing 50%–58% of global HBM revenue, ~70% of initial HBM4 allocations, and >50% LTA coverage for 2027–2028 capacity [1, 2, 13, 15]. FY2025 revenue reached KRW 97.15T (48.6% operating margin), while Q3 2026 revenue hit KRW 104.62T (79.7% margin) with 71.84% ROIC and ~$42.96B net cash [1, 2, 21]. Yet strong operations do not make a safe stock at $131.79. We assign **CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL** business quality (`PASS` KPIs), **REJECTED** (`TREND`) for new capital, and **EXIT_IMMEDIATELY** for our 17.764 held Schwab shares [22].

web_blocks.html: Optical cheapness at 3.25x forward earnings masks three real hazards [21, 22, 23]. First, the chart sits in a Stage 4 downtrend (-19.64% below its $164.00 50D SMA, 9 distribution days, -24.64% 28D RS) [22]. Second, the 5.53x ADR price-to-book multiple embeds a 43.6% premium over Seoul KRX:000660 parity ($93.48) [23, 25]. Third, SKHY carries a 3.20x beta during an active S&P 500 Correction, making waiting for a bounce to $141.36–$149.69 a negative-EV gamble [22]. Exiting immediately protects capital and preserves 100% cash.

Our rejection depends strictly on price, parity, and trend [22]. To upgrade SKHY back to actionable status, we require three clear shifts. First, price must reclaim the $164.00 50-day SMA on >=1.5x average volume (~34.2M shares/day), or build a tight VCP base above $122.20 [22]. Second, the S&P 500 must exit its Correction regime [22]. Third, Q4/FY2026 earnings (January 27–28, 2027) must confirm durable HBM4 gross margins and 2027–2028 LTAs [13, 28]. Until then, both equity and options capital stay on the sidelines.

This monograph separates price-blind business analysis (Chapters 1–6) from valuation, tape, and portfolio action (Chapters 7–9). Inside, you will find a 10-year financial audit, a unit-economics waterfall, and an ADR-to-KRX parity check. It closes with exact dollar-and-share execution triggers for Charles Schwab.

book_paragraphs: Welcome to our institutional monograph on SK hynix Inc., listed on the NASDAQ as SKHY and in Seoul as 000660. Before diving into the ten-chapter journey—from SK hynix's origins and HBM packaging breakthroughs to its ten-year financial forensics and options skew—this executive chapter lays out our bottom-line verdict for both new money and existing shares.

On the strength of its business, SK hynix has earned a remarkable place in global technology. Through its Advanced MR-MUF thermal packaging and early execution with NVIDIA, SK hynix captured 50% to 58% of global High Bandwidth Memory revenue and roughly 70% of initial HBM4 allocations, while locking in long-term agreements for more than half of its 2027 and 2028 capacity. Revenue climbed from 32.77 trillion won in the 2023 downturn to 97.15 trillion won in FY2025, and surged to 104.62 trillion won in Q3 2026 alone at a 79.7% operating margin. Trailing return on invested capital stands at 71.84%, backed by nearly $43 billion in net cash.

Yet great engineering does not override a broken stock chart or an expensive depositary structure. Because SK hynix must reinvest roughly 30% of peak revenue into fab capital expenditures and remains exposed to historical memory cyclicality, we classify its business quality as CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL with PASS operational KPIs. More importantly, on November 13, 2026, the NASDAQ ADR at $131.79 fails our entry discipline for three concrete reasons.

First, the tape is in an active Stage 4 markdown. SKHY closed down 4.30% on November 13, sitting 19.64% below its $164.00 50-day moving average, 11.96% below its $149.69 10-week EMA, and 34.06% below its $199.87 post-IPO high, with no bullish turn on the 4-hour chart. Meanwhile, the broader S&P 500 is in a Correction regime with six distribution days and a 5.10% 10-year Treasury yield.

Second, the ADR carries a hidden structural premium. Each NASDAQ SKHY ADS represents one-tenth of a Seoul ordinary share. At $131.79, U.S. investors are valuing the company at $960.57 billion, or 5.53 times book value—a 43.6% premium over the $660.29 billion valuation implied by KRX 000660 shares trading around 1.25 million won in Seoul. While 3.25x forward earnings looks optically cheap, memory stocks always look cheapest on P/E at the peak of the cycle.

Third, our probability-weighted expected value across Bull ($186.52 at 25%), Base ($125.00 at 45%—a 50/50 blend of $104.66 mid-cycle FCF value and $145.00 HBM4 cycle-extension), and Bear ($93.48 at 30%) scenarios is $130.92—or -0.7% against 29.1% downside risk and a 3.20x beta (dropping to $111.35 or -15.5% in a Bear-regime stress test). Consequently, we assign REJECTED (TREND) for new capital, and EXIT_IMMEDIATELY for our 17.764 held Schwab shares (cost basis $168.88, currently down 21.96%), selling immediately at $131.79 (~$2,341.12) and redeploying 100% into Schwab cash while MSFT ($523.88, below its $529.39 20D SMA) and TSM ($398.73, Stage 4) remain at 0%.

book_subsections.title: How to Use This Monograph
paragraphs: Chapters 1 through 6 examine SK hynix completely blind to today's stock price, testing its corporate history, HBM and Solidigm segments, MR-MUF unit economics, competitive moat, operational KPIs, and ten-year cash conversion. Chapters 7 through 9 then re-introduce the market tape, reconciling the NASDAQ ADR against Seoul parity, mapping 1W/1D/4H technical levels, and executing our No-FOMO action plan.

book_subsections.title: What Would Reverse Our Rejection
paragraphs: Our stance is anchored in discipline, not dogma. If SKHY holds the $122.20 support shelf, forms a tight Volatility Contraction Pattern, and reclaims its $164.00 50-day moving average on heavy institutional volume—ideally alongside Q4/FY2026 earnings in late January 2027—we will gladly re-underwrite the stock for Stage 2 entry.

book_subsections.title: Summary of Key Portfolio Numbers
paragraphs: To keep every execution figure at your fingertips: current market price is $131.79; the Schwab position is 17.764 shares at a $168.88 average cost ($2,341.12 market value); our action is EXIT_IMMEDIATELY at CMP $131.79 (with a hard stop below $121.34 Pivot S1 / $116.28 invalidation if staged); and our 100% redeployment parks all proceeds into Schwab cash (~4.86% 2-year Treasury benchmark) while MSFT ($523.88) and TSM ($398.73) remain at 0%.

On the options desk, implied volatility at 70.0% is cheap relative to 20-day realized volatility at 101.1%, and a conditional January 15, 2027 $130/$160 Bull Call Spread sits on standby at $10.31 debit ($1,031 max loss for $1,969 max profit). However, that January 15 expiry expires 12 to 13 days before late-January Q4/FY2026 earnings (January 27–28, 2027), creating a calendar mismatch that reinforces standing aside on options until a Stage 1 base forms and post-earnings March/April 2027 expirations are evaluated.
By combining fundamental depth with strict Stage 2 technical discipline, this dossier ensures you never confuse an extraordinary semiconductor franchise with a low-risk stock entry.

As you listen through the chapters ahead, pay special attention to the tension between SK hynix's unmatched HBM4 technology lead and the unforgiving mechanics of memory capital cycles and cross-border ADR pricing. Both truths coexist: SK hynix is a generational engineering winner, and $131.79 on a Stage 4 NASDAQ ADR is the wrong place to risk fresh capital. Let us begin in Chapter 1 with the corporate evolution that turned a debt-laden DRAM survivor into the indispensable memory partner of the AI era.

One final reminder before Chapter 1 begins: every figure in this monograph is anchored to the verified November 13, 2026 market cutoff and reconciled directly against primary filings, exchange feeds, and our live portfolio ledger. Whether you are evaluating SK hynix for the first time or managing an existing Schwab position, let the evidence—not the AI narrative—govern your next trade.

Specifically, keep three numbers at the front of your mind as you read or listen: $131.79 (our immediate exit price for all 17.764 Schwab shares), $121.34 (the Pivot S1 hard stop if staged, with $116.28 invalidation), and $125.00 (our reconciled 12-month Base Case target). Everything else in this ten-chapter dossier builds the fundamental, valuation, and technical case behind those exact execution levels.
